known_issues: Physical Windows tray/bootstrap/autostart/removable-drive integration is not yet validated on a real user machine.
Autostart trusts any drive carrying the matching .kohakuyasha-id marker and Kohakuyasha.bat (low risk, needs same UUID).
Instance lock file lives on the (possibly removable) project drive.
Physical Windows: user confirmed Kohakuyasha.bat v0.1.4 launches and works; tray menu, full diagnostics, restart and autostart/drive-letter checks not individually confirmed.
API key is stored in plain text in data/secrets.json (git-ignored, chmod 600 best effort). Windows DPAPI encryption is a candidate improvement.

Cloud.ru provider uses the OpenAI-compatible endpoint https://foundation-models.api.cloud.ru/v1 and example model ids from memory; they could not be verified offline. Both are editable in the cabinet.
Memory is retrieval-based (SQLite FTS5 with crude Russian prefix stemming), not model fine-tuning; semantic embeddings are a possible later upgrade.
Real provider calls (Anthropic, OpenAI, Cloud.ru) are verified only with mocks and a local fake server.
